description: Primary version-update bot for nuget/npm/github-actions. Dependabot version updates are disabled; Dependabot security alerts may still open PRs via repo settings.

packageRules.description: Bump NuGet versions including exact/[bracket] pins (e.g. FluentAssertions [7.2.2]).

Keep the transitive npm CLI package replaced by the local stub (package.json overrides: npm -> $eds-npm-cli-stub, tools/npm-cli-stub). Upstream npm ships bundled (inBundle) brace-expansion/tar copies that npm overrides cannot patch, so any update that restores the real npm package re-introduces those advisories (#396, #399). Release tooling publishes NuGet via @semantic-release/exec and never invokes the npm CLI plugin.
